items.title: AgentCore Gateway supports private TLS certificates for VPC endpoints
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway now supports TLS certificates signed by private certificate authorities (CAs) on MCP, OpenAPI, and HTTP proxy targets.

items.title: Amazon S3 Object Lock variable retention with event holds is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: Amazon S3 Object Lock support for variable retention with event holds is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West).

items.title: AWS Security Hub introduces remediation plans to prioritize and fix security exposures
items.blurb: AWS Security Hub now offers remediation plans that group related exposure findings sharing a root cause.

items.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now supports OpenTelemetry metrics and detailed monitoring
items.blurb: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now publishes OpenTelemetry metrics to Amazon CloudWatch for your node-based clusters, and each metric carries attributes you can filter and aggregate on with Prometheus Query Language (PromQL) expressions.

items.title: AWS Transfer Family now supports custom CloudWatch log groups for managed workflows
items.blurb: AWS Transfer Family now lets you choose a custom log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for managed workflow execution logs.

items.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports table optimization, statistics, and crawlers for Apache Iceberg V3
items.blurb: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports table optimization, statistics, and crawlers for Apache Iceberg Version 3 (V3) tables.

items.title: New Archestra's OpenAPPA Saturates Two Major Security Benchmarks with a 0% Attack Success Rate
items.blurb: Archestra released OpenAPPA, an open-source security engine designed to stop data exfiltration caused by prompt injection or model hallucination.
